INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.

5. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.

6. When learning Presentation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.
